column1: # docs/tree-design.md, stage 5a: userland/lib/ and userland/ui/ into the four named libraries,
# and the C library's three directories under userland/libs/ beside them.
# The ASSIGNMENT is computed, not chosen: a symbol graph over libuapp's objects (`nm -g`,
# 320 modules, 1,008 edges) plus each file's #includes of another module's header (74
# more -- upixel names no uimg symbol but its header includes struct uimg), each cycle
# kept in one library, every module placed in the lowest library its dependencies
# allow, from the anchors the design doc names (base < net < media < ui).
# ~/lib/x.h rows are the include form, anchored so `kernel/lib/x.h` is never touched;
# `userland/lib` itself has no row: it split four ways, so a leftover is fixed by hand.
# C library: libc first, so userland/libs/libc/ exists as a MOVE before include/ lands in it.
# The include forms, and the short `lib/x.c` a comment names a file by:
# A directory named in prose or a rule; ui/ keeps its name, under libs/:
